claims.title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

Biology lit-pull A discharged 2026-05-09 (8 entries) -- see evidence/literature/targeted_review_arc_062_rule_apprehension/. Three converging conclusions: (1) PFC rule-coding units exist and abstract over instances (Bongard & Nieder 2010 PNAS; Miller & Cohen 2001 Annu Rev Neurosci). (2) Rule-context modulation is anatomically distributed across frontoparietal+insular MD network (Mitchell et al. 2016 J Neurosci) with dissociable sub-functions across PS / OFC / ACC (Capkova/Mansouri/Buckley 2025 eNeuro). (3) All three R3 candidate gating sites are biologically real -- BG-side cortico-striatal (Gurney/Humphries/Redgrave 2015 PLoS Biology), hippocampal trajectory-proposal (Pfeiffer & Foster 2013 Nature), and PFC top-down score_bias (Miller & Cohen 2001; Bongard & Nieder 2010); the architectural commitment is a routing choice, not a metaphysical one. R2 caveat: PFC's biological mechanism is high-dimensional mixed selectivity (Rigotti et al. 2013 Nature), not discrete head selection -- ARC-062 weak reading's two-head architecture is a low-dimensional approximation suitable for SD-054's two-mode partition but expected to break at multi-strategy scaling (Phase 4 / GAP-E). MECH-309's logical-necessity claim is supported by Bongard & Nieder's abstraction-coding finding -- biology has the capacity strict Bayesian / parametric-policy learners lack; the question is what training pressure produces it.

claims.evidence_quality_note:
External corroboration (NOT REE evidence; convergent, not confirmatory): Anthropic's J-space / Jacobian-lens result (2026, anthropic.com/research/global-workspace). A large capable model, under NO design pressure to have a workspace, was found to have spontaneously developed a compact reportable bottleneck -- "a few dozen concepts at a time, less than a tenth of overall internal activity" -- that is (a) reportable, (b) causally load-bearing (ablating it drops multi-step reasoning to near-zero while fluency / sentiment / MCQ survive), and (c) bypassed by automatic processing. This is convergent evidence that a capacity-limited, reportable, integration-central broadcast channel is an ATTRACTOR for capable sequence models, which raises the prior that REE's designed-in version is doing real work. claims.title: Stereotyped behavioral signals are causal externalizations of specific internal functional states, making them cross-architecturally legible without learned convention.
claims.what_would_answer:
MECH-191 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "causally produced" and "cross-architecturally legible" are
separate assertions with OPPOSITE readiness. Split on testability, mirroring ARC-003's
Leg A/Leg B pattern.

LEG A -- CAUSAL PRODUCTION (testable now, single-agent, RECEIVER-FREE).
Testable today for 4 of the 7 catalogued signals, whose internal-state correlate already
exists in ree_core: whine (z_goal-active-without-satisfaction, ree_core/goal.py
GoalState), huff (E3 trajectory-discard fired at breath cadence, MECH-107/108's
BreathOscillator sweep logic, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py -- genuinely implemented, not a
stub), yelp (z_harm_a threshold-crossing, ree_core/amygdala/bla.py + cea.py), tail-wag
(z_beta positive-valence threshold-crossing, ree_core/agent.py). The other 3 catalog
entries are each blocked on DIFFERENT missing substrate and are NOT answered by a Leg A
pass on the other four: facial-expression needs OTHER_SELFLIKE model activation (confirmed
absent from ree_core, same grep as MECH-183 below); play-bow needs a mode-manager/play-mode
substrate (confirmed absent -- no PlayMode/mode_manager class anywhere in ree_core);
licks/petting-received is MECH-193's two-agent reward-coupling territory and is not
single-agent by construction.
NON-DEGENERACY: the internal-state channel and the candidate signal-analog event must
both show non-degenerate variance (state activates and stays quiescent across the run;
signal-analog event fires and fails to fire across the run) -- a state pinned always-on
or an event that never/always fires tests nothing.
CONFIRMING: for each of the four substrate-present signals, the internal-state activation
predicts its own signal-analog event with high specificity against the OTHER three states
and against a quiescent baseline -- a decoder trained only on the other internal-state
channels cannot recover which event fired above chance, AND ablating the state variable
itself (not merely a correlated channel) collapses the corresponding event. This is causal,
state-specific production at the level the current substrate can express it -- internal
telemetry standing in for physical externalization, the same substitution MECH-107 already
uses for "exhale."
FALSIFYING: any of the four channels shows low specificity (e.g. z_harm_a
threshold-crossings occur at similar rates during z_goal-unmet or E3-discard episodes as
during genuine harm episodes), OR ablating the state variable does not suppress its
correlated event -- undermines "causal externalization" even before any receiver exists.

LEG B -- CROSS-ARCHITECTURE LEGIBILITY (BLOCKED; not queueable as of 2026-08-08).
Requires (i) an actual externalization/broadcast channel carrying the internal state
outward -- confirmed absent: zero scent/broadcast/social-signal-output implementation
anywhere under ree_core/ (re-confirmed 2026-08-08, same finding as MECH-041's grep); the
only specification is ARC-047's seven scent fields, itself candidate, confidence 0.0,
implementation_phase v5, unbuilt; and (ii) a receiving agent with its own
other-model/attribution-stream/OTHER_SELFLIKE substrate to do the "any observer with a
corresponding internal state can map it" decoding -- confirmed absent, identical to
MECH-183's 2026-06-11 feasibility assessment, independently re-confirmed 2026-08-08.
CONFIRMING (once substrate exists): a receiving agent -- ideally of a different
architecture/training lineage than the emitter -- correctly attributes the emitter's
functional state above chance from the broadcast signal alone, AND this decoding accuracy
drops toward chance when the receiver's own homologous internal-state machinery is
ablated/absent.
FALSIFYING: even once the broadcast + other-model substrate exists, receiver decoding
accuracy is statistically indistinguishable from chance, OR indistinguishable between a
receiver WITH and WITHOUT the corresponding internal-state machinery -- either falsifies
"legible via a corresponding internal state, not learned convention."
[2026-09-10 /governance GFLAG-0175 option A] NECESSITY FRAMING MIGRATED HERE FROM MECH-192, which was
retitled to its narrowed signal-side residual on the same date. Leg B is the manipulation that carries
it: z_beta leakage can only produce functional state-matching if the perceived signal maps onto a
corresponding internal state in the observer, and stereotyped signals meet that requirement because they
are produced by the same functional states they communicate -- which is why fast empathy works
cross-species without shared language (Albuquerque 2016, Silva 2011; lit
targeted_review_social_signal_legibility). Ablating the receiver's homologous internal-state machinery,
i.e. Leg B's CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING clauses above, is what tests that necessity reading; MECH-192 now
retains only the graded signal-side residual (monotone coordination benefit in legibility at fixed
attribution coupling and matched channel information) and does not restate the necessity claim.

RELEASE CONDITION: identical substrate to MECH-183/MECH-041 -- ARC-047 (scent/broadcast
channel) plus ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-032 (other-agent modelling) landing. No separate build
is implied by MECH-191 beyond what MECH-183/MECH-041 already require.

SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]
claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- two-sided, because this test has a tuned control arm that can be
made vacuous as easily as the treatment arm. (ON side) `use_closure_operator=True` with
`use_lateral_pfc_analog=True` (enforced, agent.py:2277), on the 603n foraging-competent substrate,
and the closure path must demonstrably fire: `n_closures >= 1` AND `nogo_installed >= 1` on >= 2/3
seeds -- this is the exact gate the 2026-06-12 amend pre-registered, and the exact defect
V3-EXQ-460c hit (`n_closures = 0` despite env `sequence_completions` of 2/5/6). The residue-discharge
DV must be non-flat, i.e. reproduce V3-EXQ-466e's demonstrated separation, not sit at floor.
(OFF-tuned side) the control arm must be a real search and not a token one: at least 3 distinct
settings each of the MECH-090 beta commit/release thresholds, the MECH-260 action-history depth, and
the MECH-094 mode-gating predicate, with the BEST-performing member reported as the control, not the
mean. If `n_closures = 0` in ON, or the tuned sweep collapses to a single point, the run self-routes
`substrate_not_ready_requeue` and MUST NOT be scored in either direction. Report `n_ticks`,
`n_closures`, `n_habenula_aborts` and the `skipped:<cause>` histogram from `ClosureOperator.get_state()`
for every arm, so a null is attributable to a named skip cause rather than to "closure did nothing".

CONFIRMING: three arms -- ON, OFF-baseline, OFF-tuned. SD-034 is supported if the ON arm reproduces
the five-part token JOINTLY -- (a) MECH-090 beta release surviving `closure_decommit_hold_ticks`,
(b) targeted MECH-260 No-Go on the just-completed action class, (c) within-domain residue attenuation
with the 1e-6 floor asserted intact (the "residue cannot be erased" invariant), (d) a `closure_event`
reaching SD-032a, (e) MECH-268 dACC pe rebaseline -- while the OFF-tuned arm reproduces at most ONE
of the five; and if the ON-vs-OFF-tuned gap on the 466e residue-discharge DV exceeds
max(1.5 x the pooled SD of the per-seed ON-minus-OFF-tuned delta, an absolute floor of 10% of the
OFF-baseline within-domain residue mass) on >= 2/3 seeds. Scoring the five components SEPARATELY is
load-bearing: a scalar composite would let a large residue effect mask the absence of the No-Go
pulse, which is precisely the failure the 2026-06-12 amend was built to fix.

within 1 SD of ON on >= 2/3 seeds. Then closure is emergent from the existing MECH-090/MECH-260/
MECH-094 substrate and SD-034 is over-specification -- this is the claim's own primary falsifier,
unchanged. SECONDARY (also the claim's own, and it routes elsewhere rather than weakening SD-034):
if ON resolves verified-but-not-released but introduces PREMATURE disengagement -- beta released

the same margin -- then the SD-033a completion-condition detector or the mode-conditioning logic is
wrong, not the operator; that outcome self-routes to the detector and MUST NOT be recorded as a
weakens on SD-034.

COUPLING face and the de-commit MAGNITUDE face are NOT in scope. They were decomposed out to

The substrate ADVANCED; the mechanism is not falsified by non-occupancy any longer.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION, currently NOT satisfied: the readiness gate used to grade every 464/467/934/935-series run (min_across_arms(fraction_in_external_task) > floor) is itself confirmed CORRUPTING (2026-08-13 autopsy): it is anti-correlated with the claim's own predicted effect (stronger hysteresis drives occupancy toward 0 at high caps, failing the gate even when hysteresis is working as designed), conflates 'mode unreachable' with 'mode saturated,' and has emitted at least one factually-false route_reason. A non_contributory verdict obtained under this gate cannot be read as evidence against MECH-266 until the gate is restated per-arm/regime-conditioned rather than min-across-a- swept-range.
CONFIRMING (H1, graded arbitration): once the gate is fixed, a cap-value sweep (or a margin-normalised rule, per V3-EXQ-935's own direction) reveals a genuine mixed/graded operating regime at some accessible cap -- occupancy varying continuously with the hysteresis parameter rather than switching discretely -- AND varying exit_threshold within that regime reproduces a graded under-binding/over-binding behavioural continuum.
FALSIFYING (H2, structurally bang-bang): even under the corrected gate, no cap value or regime-conditioning produces anything but a step function (occupancy ~1.0 below some r, ~0.0 above it, n_switches == n_episodes invariant) -- the discrete argmax register the mode selection sits on is structurally bang-bang at this substrate's resolution. This would not falsify the Schmitt-trigger's existence, but would falsify its GRADED framing. V3-EXQ-934's own evidence (2026-08-15) already leans toward this: no single cap graded on more than 1 of 3 seeds. H2 is not yet eliminated.
Cross-reference: this is the twin case to MECH-267's gate situation -- 'mechanism partially real, current instrument unreliable' -- cite that entry's framing rather than re-deriving it.

claims.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The AT-tick persistent-handle fix (ree-v3 main
31ed78e, landed 2026-08-01, sd_id arc071_e3_reselection_on_committed_program,
implemented_validated) must be ACTIVE and its object-identity DV live. Concretely,
in every cell: n_genuine_commits_identity_based MUST be strictly less than
(n_e3_ticks + n_episodes_probe). Equality is the exact V3-EXQ-871a defect
signature -- E3 recreating a fresh committed-trajectory object at every tick, zero
exceptions -- under which every commit-persistence DV is arithmetically forced and
the run measures the wiring, not the gate. Additionally: the flag
use_persistent_committed_program_handle must be scoped to the PROBE phase only and
left at its lineage default during formation (the V3-EXQ-871 defect: setting it
cell-wide changes select_action's between-tick fast path and cascades through
RNG-coupled env dynamics into different chunk formation -- same seeds 101/505
formed 1/0 chunks vs 2/2 under V3-EXQ-841). Report the DV tick-rate-normalised
(n_genuine_commits / n_e3_ticks), NOT as raw mean segment length: the
_segment_commitments() 'idx <= prev_idx => new segment' rule reports a spurious
length-1 segment at every E3-tick boundary even when the handle correctly persists,
so raw segment length under-reports a genuinely fixed substrate.
CONFIRMING: measured at the PROPAGATION boundary, upstream of the
committed-selection argmin and therefore NOT subject to the G4 shared-conversion
absorption. (1) Bistable concordance: gate elevates on entry to committed state and
holds; hold_concordance and release_concordance both ~1.0 across a trained
(low-variance, committed) and a fresh (high-variance, uncommitted) agent -- the
EXQ-049e two-condition design, the canonical PASS and still the strongest evidence
for this claim. (2) Interrupt selectivity: the elevated gate re-opens on a genuine
surprise-gated variance spike but NOT on expected harm contact (EXQ-062b).
(3) Post-fix persistence: with the AT-tick fix active, tick-rate-normalised
genuine-commit count is strictly below the tick count and committed-program object
identity survives across E3 ticks. (4) R-c admission discriminates:
mech090_n_elevation_blocked > 0 under the V3-EXQ-592 seed-42 degenerate signature
(running_variance ~1e-5 with nav_competence 0.0) AND mech090_n_elevation_admitted >
0 when readiness clears -- the gate blocks the trivial-predictability basin without
permanently locking out commitment.
FALSIFYING: (1) With the AT-tick fix confirmed active and the tick-rate-normalised
DV live, committed-trajectory identity still fails to persist across E3 ticks --
the gate cannot hold a commitment at all, and the propagation/internal-update
distinction has no substrate referent. (2) E3 internal model state is shown to
propagate to policy output DURING an elevated-beta committed sequence (measured as
a change in selected action attributable to an E3 update, with the gate confirmed
elevated) -- falsifies the claim's core distinction directly, measured at the
propagation boundary. (3) The R-c admission conjunction is shown to be
arithmetically inert: blocked-count zero across a regime that includes the
reproduced seed-42 degenerate signature, with counters confirmed wired.
NOT FALSIFYING, and this must be stated because it has been misread FOUR TIMES in
this claim's own history (592d C1 instrumentation defect, 592e hold-rate, 592f
FAIL_NO_RELEASE_AUTHORITY, 630 unattributable OFF baseline): any result in which
the R-c predicates FIRE but produce no discriminative committed-state OCCUPANCY.
That is the admission-only-by-design reach gap; the release authority was moved to
MECH-342 and VALIDATED there (V3-EXQ-592g PASS, 2/stage decommit transitions in
B/C/D, mech342_fires 1/stage, no false abort in A/E). Route such a result to
MECH-342, never to this claim.
OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (stated, not dropped): "Do BG-level beta oscillations (~13-30Hz,
STN/striatum) gate output propagation without gating internal model updating in
biological brains?" is an electrophysiology question tested outside REE and
answered there -- Jenkinson & Brown 2011, Frank 2005, Frank/Seeberger/O'Reilly
2004, Redgrave/Prescott/Gurney 1999. NOT REE's to test, and the claim's own
functional_restatement already concedes "the biological mechanism (beta in
STN/striatum) is one implementation; it is not required in the ANN substrate."
Scope limits already recorded and still binding: the output-only-gating property
holds at the BG level and does NOT generalise to cortical beta (Hosaka 2016: SMA
beta gates internal plan-representation stability), and post-movement beta rebound
carries internal-model-confidence information (Tan 2016), so the BG gate is not a
dumb switch. The REE leg is solely: does the ANN substrate need a commitment-gated
routing variable decoupling E3 forward pass from policy output, distinct from E3
internal updating?

claims.title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).

falsifier tests. V3-EXQ-592g (forced state-machine diagnostic) passed all six
acceptance criteria -- including C4, the conjunction criterion 592f could only
pass VACUOUSLY, now strictly positive (max_drop 0.6) -- so "does the pressure
accumulator/release-bound machinery fire as coded" is closed. What remains open
is whether the mechanism, once ecologically triggered, produces adaptive
behaviour -- promotion to provisional/active requires exactly that: an
ecological, evidence-grade experiment, not another diagnostic probe.

measurement_test_design_defect, NOT a verdict): a run only tests MECH-342 if it
first establishes GENUINE sustained commitment (beta latch elevated on real
nav-competence/foraging engagement, not a forced state) in >= 2/3 seeds, AND the
readiness-degradation manipulation (score_margin and/or nav_competence actually
crossing their release-triggering floors mid-commitment) is verified non-vacuous.

seeds (foraging contact-guard held on seed 43 only); V3-EXQ-629c (autopsied
2026-07-24) failed it entirely (contact_rate 0, 3 gates false) and was
categorised measurement_test_design_defect, explicitly NOT a substrate_ceiling
hit, precisely because the ecological scenario never materialised. A future
retest must confirm >= 2/3 seeds clear the same nav-competence/contact floor
629b used before treating any release/non-release result as informative. Note
also the adjacent, still-open frozen_z_goal_scaffold_family finding

to reopen), but a retest inheriting the same harness should re-verify the goal

CONFIRMING signature: once the precondition above is cleared, commit_maintenance
_release fires (mech342_fires > 0) at the point score_margin and/or
nav_competence cross their release floors; the release is TARGETED (only the
degraded committed program is released -- unrelated ongoing behaviour is

ON/OFF ablation over the same degradation episodes (e.g. reduced
wasted/hazardous persistence in a now-unwinnable commitment) without an increase

still-viable commitment, non-targeted release bleeding into unrelated ongoing
programs, or oscillatory re-commit/release churn. Any of these, replicated on a
properly-powered ecological run (i.e. not a repeat of the 629b/629c
precondition-failure mode), falsifies the ecological-benefit claim without
reopening the already-closed diagnostic-correctness question from 592g.

claims.title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
claims.what_would_answer:
SCOPE, ratified 2026-06-14 and load-bearing for reading this falsifier. MECH-341 asserts
scoring-layer PRESERVATION -- that E3 score aggregation does not collapse an upstream-diverse
candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. It does NOT assert that the preserved
diversity reaches the COMMITTED action; that conversion is the shared E3 selection-authority
ceiling tracked on `behavioral_diversity_isolation:GAP-A` / MECH-439 F-dominance, and is MECH-442's
territory, not this claim's. A flat committed-action-class entropy is therefore not evidence
against MECH-341 (614e and 660 both showed byte-identical committed-class entropy while MECH-341
passed). Two falsifier shapes are additionally RETIRED and must not be resurrected:
(a) graded-in-K dose-response -- retired by confirmed `failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-660b_2026-06-11`
because a graded response over-specifies a binary preserve-or-collapse claim (three convergent
iterations 660 / 660a / 660b; no 660c); (b) in-isolation clearance via the
`entropy_bias_scale` lever -- V3-EXQ-616 proved mathematically that a uniform additive bias
cannot move a single-class CEM proposer output (bit-identical across scales 1/2/4/8), so the
B_only arm's structural bound sits at the *proposer* layer (SP-CEM presence), not the score-layer
knob. MECH-341 is a preserver, never an in-isolation generator.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION.
(1) There must be something to preserve, and this is the condition every run to date missed.
Measured `mean_distinct_first_action_classes` in the PRE-scoring candidate pool must be
`>= 0.9 * action_dim` (>= 4.5 of 5), i.e. `support_preserving_min_first_action_classes` raised to
`action_dim` -- see ARC-065's own `what_would_answer` (P1) for the full statement and the
V3-EXQ-949 evidence; do not re-derive it here. At the shipped default of 2 the pool realises
~2-3 classes and `min_classes_for_stratification = 2` is only just satisfied, so a "preservation"
verdict is measured at the mechanism's degenerate boundary.
(2) The substrate must be OPERATIVE and measured as such, not assumed from config
(`use_e3_score_diversity` and both sub-flags default `False`): `n_stratified_fired > 0` on every
ON arm and every seed (the V3-EXQ-611 C1 criterion -- 611's ARM_2 recorded
`n_stratified_fired = 0` across all seeds and that FAIL was a wiring artefact, not a claim result),
and `entropy_bonus_max_abs` non-trivial relative to the observed `mean_top2_class_gap` (the 611c
C2 lesson: `lambda = 0.05` produced a 0.045 bonus against gaps of 0.27-1.96 and was inert; the
defaults are now `lambda = 0.5`, `bias_scale = 1.0`).
(3) De-duplication: the pre/post class counts and the within-class representative entropy must
be accumulated on the fresh-select denominator (`experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py` -- select
diagnostics cleared before every `select_action`, latched ticks contribute no row), with
`n_fresh_select`, `n_latched` and `replication_factor` reported per cell. A held/latched E3 decision
re-counted per tick inflates every class count by the hold factor (~9x) and is the standing
hold-weighted readout hazard.
(4) SD-105 (selection-entropy headroom floor) OFF or matched-constant with realised log-temperature
recorded per arm.

CONFIRMING. On a pool with measured `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5`: the number of
distinct first-action classes SURVIVING the E3 scoring step (post-score, pre-commit) is
strict-above the same quantity with `use_e3_score_diversity = False`, on >= 2/3 seeds; and the
established within-class-representative readout `H(rep_signature | committed_class)` (the 660
corrected readout mandated by the 614e autopsy's Learning #2 -- not committed-class entropy)
remains strict-above legacy-argmin by a margin exceeding both an absolute floor and the
cross-seed SD of the delta. The already-established instance at the clamped pool is 660:
4.862 vs 4.781 nats, +0.081 against a 0.05 threshold -- note this margin is thin and its
SD-scaled robustness was never established, which is part of what the raised-P1 arm would test.

FALSIFYING. Two distinct routes, either sufficient.
(i) Collapse at a genuinely diverse pool: with `mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5`
upstream and the substrate measured operative, the post-scoring distinct-class count does NOT
exceed the `use_e3_score_diversity = False` control (the diverse pool is collapsed by scoring
regardless of the preserver) -- MECH-341's preservation assertion fails exactly where it should
bite hardest. (ii) Boundary artefact: the 660 within-class-representative lift does not
replicate at the raised pool -- at ~4.9 classes the niches are small (often singletons, where
`stratified_select`'s own code short-circuits to argmin: `len(class_idxs) < 2`), so a +0.08 nats
effect that vanishes when niches shrink would indicate the ratified result was an artefact of the
2-class clamp rather than a property of the preserver. Either outcome is a genuine weakening and
would put the 2026-06-14 ratification back in front of governance.

claims.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.
claims.what_would_answer:
Answered by a multi-arm behavioural ablation of the diversity-generation
substrates on an ARMED conversion stack -- not by any run in the
569/687/707/708/714 lineage, all of which were measured against a class-entropy
ceiling they were already at.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (ARMED-CONVERSION; shared with MECH-440 and MECH-441,
which cross-reference this text rather than restating it). Two independently-
defaulting config clamps must BOTH be lifted, and both asserted from MEASURED
per-arm quantities, not from the config:
 (P1) support_preserving_min_first_action_classes = action_dim, with measured
 mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim in every arm. At the
 shipped default of 2 (set literally at 273 driver call sites) the candidate pool
 realises only ~2.16-3.08 distinct first-action classes of 5, so committed-CLASS
 entropy is capped at ln(~3) ~ 1.08 nats IDENTICALLY IN EVERY ARM -- an
 arm-invariant ceiling no diversity lever can move. V3-EXQ-708b measured
 precommit_n_distinct_classes_mean = 2.959 / 2.958 / 2.956 across its three arms
 with precommit_class_entropy at 97.8% of that ceiling in the OFF baseline.
 (P2) use_modulatory_selection_authority = True, with measured
 authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05 in every arm bearing a modulatory lever
 (~1e-8 is the OFF signature). With authority OFF, a per-candidate modulatory
 contribution is added at fixed small magnitude to scores whose raw range is
 10-560, and cannot move the argmin by construction.
 Both load-bearing, neither substitutes for the other: V3-EXQ-949 (5 seeds)
 measured yoked committed-action divergence 0.000 with P1 alone, 0.000 with P2
 alone, 0.3675 with both. A null with either clamp in place is VACUOUS and must
 self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never weakens.
 A third precondition remains from the original design: ARC-062's gated policy
 heads and learned context discriminator must be ON in every arm, so that a
 monomodal outcome is attributable to absent diversity rather than an absent
 consumer of it.
WHERE MEASURED / WHY NOT ABSORBED: primary DV is committed_class_entropy over the
episode -- the terminal output of E3 selection, downstream of every candidate
scorer, eligibility gate, shortlist and argmin, so nothing remains to absorb it.
Three MANDATORY instruments, whose absence made the prior lineage unreadable:
(i) mean_distinct_first_action_classes per arm as a covariate, so the
combinatorial ceiling ln(distinct) is VISIBLE and the DV is reported as a FRACTION
of it rather than an absolute nat count; (ii) yoked-pair per-tick committed-action
divergence against a matched control arm sharing a private RNG stream (the
V3-EXQ-949 design), which detects authority acquisition even when episode-level
entropy has not yet moved; (iii) authority_rel_deviation_mean per arm, so P2 is
witnessed rather than assumed.
CONFIRMING: on an armed stack, complete ablation of the diversity-generation
pathway (LC-NE tonic floor OFF + structured curiosity OFF + striatal novelty OFF,
ARC-062 gating ON) drives committed-class entropy to monomodal collapse -- a
fraction-of-ceiling at or near its floor -- while at least one single-substrate-ON
arm reaches a strictly higher fraction-of-ceiling on >=2/3 seeds by a margin scaled
on the SD of the paired delta plus an absolute floor. The partial-ON arms then
discriminate load-bearing from contributory among the substrates. ARC-065 is
confirmed as an ARCHITECTURAL SLOT if ANY substrate arm lifts the DV; it does not
require that all four do, and its own text says so.
FALSIFYING: on a fully armed stack (P1 and P2 both witnessed, ARC-062 gating ON,
ceiling headroom demonstrably present -- fraction-of-ceiling in the ALL-OFF arm
materially below 1.0), the ALL-ON arm's committed-class entropy is statistically
indistinguishable from the ALL-OFF arm AND from a matched-magnitude noise control,
on >=2/3 seeds. Then diversity generation is not the missing architectural function
and the collapse must be re-rooted to the representation ceiling (INV-088 z_world
under-differentiation) or to F-dominance (MECH-439). Note the asymmetry
deliberately: a null in the ALL-OFF arm is uninformative (nothing to lift), so the
ceiling-headroom check is a precondition on the FALSIFYING branch specifically.
SCOPE SPLIT OWED ON SUBSTRATE (b): currently lumps striatal novelty (MECH-314a),
frontopolar uncertainty (MECH-314b) and learning-progress curiosity (MECH-314c)
into one "curiosity" slot. MECH-458 splits that slot by POLARITY: density-
attraction curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier contributing
0.00 diversity force at the decision point and 0 directed behaviour on an unshaped
map, while uncertainty- and disagreement-driven curiosity (MECH-314b/c, MECH-441)
carry the opposite, Bellemare polarity. Any curiosity arm must DECLARE which
polarity it instantiates and record a visitation-density covariate.

claims.title: bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).
claims.what_would_answer:
A two-arm learning-curve comparison on a no-external-cue substrate where
the rule must be discovered from the observed-behaviour stream, matched
by a second run on a cued-control substrate where the rule is
externally signalled. This operationalises the design the claim's own
functional_restatement already specifies.

DESIGN: ARM_0 = ARC-062-alone (top-down gated-policy + learned context
discriminator, the existing V3 rule-apprehension instantiation). ARM_1
= ARC-062 + ARC-064 children (at minimum the load-bearing subset of
MECH-316 cross-episode regularity extraction, MECH-317 behavioural-
pattern compression, MECH-318 rule-state abstraction). Substrate
candidates named in the claim's own evidence_quality_note: SD-054
extended with hidden cross-episode structure (a transition/reward
contingency that varies between two regimes with NO externally
observable cue distinguishing them), or a serial-reaction-time-task
analog with hidden sequence structure. Run BOTH arms on BOTH the
no-cue substrate and a matched cued-control variant (same substrate,
rule signalled by an explicit external cue).

CONFIRMED if, on the no-cue substrate, ARM_1 produces a measurably
better learning curve than ARM_0 (lower episodes-to-criterion, higher
terminal reward, or earlier behavioural divergence between the hidden
regimes) AND, on the cued-control substrate, ARM_1 gives no material
benefit over ARM_0 (consistent with "ARC-062 alone suffices when the
cue is external"). This dissociation -- large ARC-064 contribution
only where the rule must be discovered -- is what would establish
bottom-up rule discovery as architecturally distinct, load-bearing
functionality rather than a redundant restatement of the top-down
pathway.

FALSIFIED if, on the no-cue substrate, ARM_1 does not outperform ARM_0
beyond noise (adding MECH-316/317/318 gives no measurable
learning-curve advantage even when the rule genuinely must be
discovered from behaviour alone), OR if ARM_0 alone already solves the
no-cue task at a rate matching ARM_1 (existing top-down/updater
machinery already suffices for what looks like "discovery," so the
claimed bottom-up/top-down architectural distinction is not
load-bearing). Either result argues ARC-064 does not name a separate
architectural function from ARC-062.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all required before either verdict is
interpretable):
(1) The no-cue substrate must not be trivially solvable by chance or
rote memorisation independent of any rule-discovery machinery -- ARM_0
(or a null/random-policy control) must not already saturate
near-ceiling performance on the no-cue task for reasons unrelated to
rule discovery (e.g. an episode horizon too short for the hidden
regime to matter, or a reward structure solvable by a fixed policy
regardless of regime).
(2) The comparison must clear the SAME structural conversion-ceiling
bottleneck already identified on the sibling ARC-062/MECH-309
falsifier line (MECH-439 F-dominance / E3 commit-selection-authority
coupling -- V3-EXQ-654-series through 700b, most recently reconfirmed
unresolved by V3-EXQ-851, 2026-08-01): whatever bottom-up-derived rule
signal MECH-316/317/318 mint must be shown to actually reach committed
action (readiness gates analogous to the ARC-062 GAP-B C1 gates), not
merely exist in representation. Absent that check, a null ARM_1 result
is confounded with the known selection-authority washout rather than
informative about the top-down/bottom-up architectural question -- the
same failure mode V3-EXQ-606 (below) ran into for MECH-318 alone.
(3) MECH-316/317/318 must exist as at least minimally functional
substrate before the comparison can run at all.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): none of the three
preconditions are met. MECH-316, MECH-317, and MECH-318 all remain
candidate/v3_pending with zero built substrate; their most recent
live_status.as_of is 2026-07-11 with no evidence beyond the original
2026-05-10 literature registration, except MECH-318, which has one

(2026-05-21, "ARC-064 GAP-I MECH-318 multi-rule empirical gate") ran
C3 rule_state_active PASS (wiring live) but C1/C2 behavioural
cross-regime tests failed on 2/3 seeds, self-routed as premature --
fired before its resume_condition (V3-EXQ-543k contributory PASS) was
met. That condition still is not met (543k itself is FAIL/mixed).
MECH-309 (ARC-064's other direct dependency) remains

(2026-08-01, V3-EXQ-851 autopsy); the decisive V3-EXQ-700b test

claims.title: rule_state_abstraction_substrate (meta_RL_recurrent_task_state_representation). A mechanism for abstracting the higher-level rule-state itself as a latent variable in the agent's representation, supporting policy adaptation that depends on inferred rule-context rather than only observable cue. Biological substrate: OFC cognitive map (Wilson, Takahashi, Schoenbaum & Niv 2014; Schuck et al. 2016 OFC encodes task state). Computational analog: meta-RL recurrent task-state representation (Wang et al. 2018 prefrontal-as-meta-RL; Duan et al. 2016 RL^2; Botvinick et al. 2019 review). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery. ABSORPTION CHECK 2026-05-10: VERDICT (B) PARTIALLY ABSORBED. Within-V3 functional weight is borne by SD-033a LateralPFCAnalog rule_state buffer (W1 EMA recurrence + W3 substrate-readiness + W4 downstream bias) plus ARC-062 Phase 1 gated_policy multi-stream context discriminator (W3 per-tick rule-context discrimination + W4 score-aggregation training pressure), with ARC-062 Phase 3 GAP-C planned wiring closing the loop between the two. Two residual gaps remain: W2 (multi-task training distribution -- blocked on multi-rule-context substrate, SD-054 single-context insufficient) and W5 (cross-episode hidden-state continuity -- likely V4-scope; SD-033a per-episode reset is architecturally load-bearing for the rest of the agent state machine). Empirical retire-vs-promote verdict deferred to V3-EXQ-543c-successor on multi-rule-context substrate. See REE_assembly/docs/architecture/mech_318_absorption_check.md.
